_comment: Sprite studio settings (see tools/sprite_studio.gd). kit_folder = where the 3D models are; output_folder = where the building pictures go. For each building id from data/buildings.json: model = file in the kit, turn = quarter turns (0-3) so its front faces the camera, tiles = how many tiles wide it stands (default 1), kit_folder (optional) = look for this one model somewhere else. Our own models are made in Blender by the scripts in art/blender/ and saved to art/models/ (how-to: art/README.md). The rest are TEMPORARY stand-ins from Kenney City Kit (Commercial) 2.1, CC0, https://kenney.nl/assets/city-kit-commercial - not committed to Git; re-download into Sprites kit/ to re-run the studio on another computer.

wheat_farm._tiles_note: Model is designed for 2x2; set tiles to 2 once buildings get 2x2 footprints in the game rules
